title: Verify: Layer ordering and content-to-entity creation unit tests
summary: Prove buildScene orders layers and maps content to entities with a mocked render context.
description: Unit tests with a fake RenderContext and a mocked Phaser module cover layer depth ordering, content to entity creation and visibility filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Depth order test passes for all six layers
Position, scale and visibility cases pass
technical_constraints: Phaser mocked via vi.mock('phaser'); fake RenderContext records calls

steps.action: Add test 'orders layers background<furniture<objects<characters<effects<ui' asserting LAYER_ORDER.map(layerDepth) is strictly increasing and layerDepth(undefined) equals LAYER_DEPTH.objects.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/layers.test.ts

steps.action: Build a fake RenderContext recording addImage/setDepth/setScale calls; use a SceneDef built from tests/fixtures/valid-world.ts shaped data with objects on every layer, one with visibleWhen {flag:'x'} and flag unset. Assert entity count excludes the hidden one, depths are sorted ascending, position and scale are forwarded, and appending an extra ObjectDef adds one entity.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/buildScene.test.ts

steps.action: Mock phaser like tests/bootScene.test.ts with Scene having add.image and events.once spies; set useGameStore state from createInitialState(world, scene); call new WorldScene().create() and assert add.image was called once per visible bedroom object and SHUTDOWN handler registered.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/worldScene.test.ts
